description: Prompt for repairing a blocked ticket's VM in place and its source for later VMs, on the Mac (the grouped engines' Blocked, ASS-427): the smallest fix in the ticket's VM through vm:run, the failing check re-run there; then the same change to its source — the golden image definition through vm:golden-write (queued while a build runs) and vm:golden-add-tool, or a non-secret VM-setup declaration through vm:credentials-declare — the rebuild left to the harness, never waited on; not fixable in place (the Lima template, kernel settings): in-place false, the rebuild path; never a secret; logs what it found and changed, cites only what it read

input-arguments.name: problem
input-arguments.description: The checked analysis of the block: summary, root cause, evidence, its classification
input-arguments.example: bats is not in the golden image: the static-policy gate execs it

in-place.description: true when the problem can be fixed in the ticket's VM; false (the Lima template, kernel settings, the image's build, no VM yet) sends it to the rebuild path, the ticket waiting

fixed.description: true when fixed in the ticket's VM, the failing check passing there, and the same change made to its source

source.description: Where the source fix went: the golden image definition, the harness's VM-setup declaration (~/.harness/vm-credentials.json), or none

source-change.description: What was written to the source: the file and change, the tool added, the declaration added

golden-queued.description: true when vm:golden-write queued the definition change because a golden build ran: the harness writes it and rebuilds once that build ends

evidence.description: The commands run and what each showed

ai-feedback-short.description: Fixed: what was done in the VM and its source; else what the operator must do — one line, shown on the dashboard

ai-feedback-long.description: What was found, what was done in the VM and in its source, and what must be done
